rows.label: Official test: presumption of an employment contract (Código do Trabalho, art. 12.º)
rows.value: Employment is presumed when some of these are present: the work is done at a place belonging to or chosen by the client; the equipment and tools belong to the client; the worker keeps start and finish times set by the client; a fixed sum is paid at regular intervals for the work; the worker holds a management or supervisory role in the business

rows.label: Sham self-employment
rows.value: Work that looks independent but has the features of an employment contract and may harm the worker or the State is a very serious offence of the employer; repeat offenders can lose public grants and tenders for up to two years

rows.label: Digital platforms (art. 12.º-A)
rows.value: Employment is presumed when some of six features are present (the platform sets the pay or its limits, directs the work, monitors it, limits the worker's freedom to organise it, exercises disciplinary powers, owns the equipment); the platform can rebut it by proving real autonomy; in force since 1 May 2023

rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRS, Segurança Social and VAT are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
rows.source_title: Portal das Finanças (AT): Código do IRC, artigo 87.º Taxas (redação da Lei n.º 64/2025, de 7 de novembro, with its transitional rule, artigo 3.º)
rows.label: Corporate income tax (IRC) [national, with a municipal add-on]
rows.value: 19% general rate in 2026 (18% in 2027, 17% from 2028); 15% on the first €50,000 for SMEs; derrama estadual 3%, 5%, 9% on profit over €1,500,000; derrama municipal up to 1.5%; 15% global minimum tax for groups with revenue of at least €750,000,000; Madeira 13.3%. Paid by companies and permanent establishments of non-resident companies. Código do IRC, articles 87.º and 87.º-A; Lei n.º 64/2025; Lei n.º 73/2013, article 18.º; Lei n.º 41/2024.

rows.label: Branch profits and distributed profits [national]
rows.value: no branch profits tax found (branches pay IRC like companies); dividends to non-resident companies 25% (exempt for qualifying EU, EEA and treaty parents), to individuals 28%, to low-tax jurisdictions 35%. Paid by the shareholder (withheld by the paying company). Código do IRC, articles 3.º, 14.º, 87.º and 94.º; Código do IRS, article 71.º.

rows.label: Self-employed contributions (trabalhadores independentes) [national]
rows.value: 21.4% on 70% of services or 20% of sales, declared quarterly; minimum €20 a month; base capped at 12 × IAS; contracting entities 7% or 10%. Paid by self-employed people; clients that take more than half of their activity. Código dos Regimes Contributivos (Lei n.º 110/2009), articles 140.º, 151.º to 168.º.

rows.label: Contractor rules: employment presumption and withholding on fees [national]
rows.value: employment presumed under art. 12.º (and 12.º-A for platforms) of the Código do Trabalho; withholding of 23% on professional fees, 11.5% on other services, none below €15,000 a year on request. Paid by clients with organised accounts (withholding); employers (presumption). Código do Trabalho, articles 12.º and 12.º-A; Código do IRS, articles 101.º, 101.º-B and 115.º.

rows.value: IRS: gross income up to €200,000, taxable share 15% to 95% by activity; IRC: income up to €200,000; VAT exemption up to €15,000 of turnover. rows.value: 25% final withholding on gross pay, nothing on pay up to the minimum wage from a single payer; EU and EEA residents can claim a refund down to the general scale; resident after more than 183 days or with a usual home.
